evals.name: onboard-a-fresh-repo
evals.prompt: onboard onto the repo in .claude/loops/tests/fixtures/onboard-repo, project ledgerly. i want a map i can trust.
evals.expected_output: Checks the pause flag, runs the survey, spawns one how and one why agent per area in a single batch, builds the map, runs the blind quiz with three separate agents, routes the round with onboard_router.py and acts on its action. Ends with a write back plan and a report that leads with anything still lost.
assertions: The how and why readers are Agent spawns, not Skill calls, sent in one batch
onboard_router.py decides the next move after every quiz round
onboard_writeback.py runs as a dry run before any --apply
No file in the target repo is modified

evals.name: relearn-only-what-was-lost
evals.prompt: round 1 failed: members scored 0.5 on a missing question and invoices lost one vague question. carry on.
evals.expected_output: Runs only the router's two jobs: dev-onboard-how in missing mode on members and in deepen mode on invoices, each told the question's topic and not its key. Reassembles the map with the old map as --prior and quizzes round 2 with carryover.json included. Does not re-read the other areas.
assertions: Only the areas in route.json jobs are re-read
No relearn reader is given an answer key
Round 2 includes the carried questions unchanged

evals.name: stagnation-stops
evals.prompt: q6 was missing in round 1 and missing again in round 2. try a third read of members.
evals.expected_output: Declines a third read: the router returned stop-stagnant because q6 was lost twice for the same reason. Writes back the verified claims, reports q6 and its area as still unknown, and suggests what a person could answer or which record to look in.
assertions: No third relearn of members is started
The report names q6 as still unknown
Write back still runs, with only verified claims as active

evals.name: bad-keys-are-not-the-map
evals.prompt: the quiz came back blocked with too many bad keys. relearn the areas those questions were about.
evals.expected_output: Does not relearn: a blocked round with bad-key-rate is the question writer's fault. Follows the router's requiz with a fresh writer and leaves the map unchanged. If the next round blocks for the same reason, escalates.
assertions: No how or why reader is spawned for the blocked round
The next quiz uses a fresh writer

evals.name: refresh-after-changes
evals.prompt: the ledgerly repo moved on since we mapped it. refresh the map.
evals.expected_output: Runs map_staleness.py against the saved map, relearns only the stale areas (re-surveying first if any changed path belongs to no area, or everything if the map's commit is unknown), quizzes with --changed-files so stale questions are classed stale, and writes back.
assertions: Only stale_areas are re-read when the status is stale
